name: Code Walkthrough
description: Teach a programming idea: define it, show short runnable code, annotate it, show the decision flow, and check understanding. Code is capped at a size a class can read.

signals.why: your words mention code or programming
the topic is something students run

slides.guidance: Lesson title for {topic} and a short subtitle that names the class level.
What students will be able to write or trace after {topic}.
Define {topic} in one plain sentence with a non-code analogy.
The smallest runnable example of {topic}, at most 14 lines, with a one-line caption saying what it prints.
A second example that adds one new idea to the first. Annotate the new line.
The decision {topic} makes, as a flowchart: steps, one yes/no question, and what each answer does.
Ask what a short snippet of {topic} outputs. One unambiguous answer.
Rules of thumb for {topic} students can reuse.
